description: Runs your own ComfyUI workflow for each segment, on one or more ComfyUI servers. Add the workflow to the project's assets (exported with Export (API)); its {{tags}} become the speaker's settings.

workerSettings.label: Servers
workerSettings.description: ComfyUI addresses (host:port), one per line. With Parallel workers above 1, the workers take turns over the servers (worker 1 the first server, worker 2 the second, and so on).

workerSettings.label: Timeout (s)
workerSettings.description: How long to wait for one generation on a server, including time in ComfyUI's queue.

settings.label: Workflow
settings.description: A ComfyUI workflow from the project's assets (exported with Workflow > Export (API)). Its {{tags}} appear below as settings; {{text}}, {{seed}} and {{duration}} are filled in from the segment.
